upstream.name: Image Edit (Flux.2 Klein 4B).json
upstream.note: Official Klein base blueprint sampler/model pins retained. Masked img2img is a project experimental derivation, not an official masked blueprint. Core commit 12d5279438bfefc058a269eae805ceab6047777f: nodes.py SetLatentNoiseMask; comfy_extras/nodes_mask.py MaskToImage/ImageToMask; nodes.py ImageScale; comfy_extras/nodes_custom_sampler.py SplitSigmasDenoise and SamplerCustomAdvanced preserve denoise_mask. No image painting or geometry repair. Target scaling resolution_steps is 16 to avoid VAE center-cropping misalignment with resized mask; object reference scaling remains 1. Core comfy/sd.py vae_encode_crop_pixels and nodes_post_processing.py ImageScaleToTotalPixels justify this intentional difference.

evidence.note: Unmodified official blueprint at pinned Git blob; public source https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/blob/12d5279438bfefc058a269eae805ceab6047777f/blueprints/Image%20Edit%20(Flux.2%20Klein%204B).json; normalized to Git LF bytes (Windows checkout was CRLF)

filename_prefix.help: 存檔前綴，預設是固定前綴。不用 output_prefix，避免被改成 gameart/...

object_ref.help: Image 2: object reference; purpose must be explained in prompt.

mask.help: Confirmed RGBA mask: alpha 0 selects edit, alpha 255 preserves. LoadImage MASK is resized to scaled target.

denoise.help: Fraction of the fixed 20-step sigma schedule tail; actual sampled steps vary.

fixed_notes: Fixed model pins, Euler, CFG5 and 20-step source scheduler. Sampling uses target VAE latent plus confirmed noise mask and low-sigma tail. No dedicated inpaint model, no RGB pixel preservation guarantee; final source composite may still be required.
